scope: Reuse frozen tuiscotti harness and current runner for fresh approved-cohort capture and baseline replay only. No alternate PTY/capture harness.
reuse: prepare_live_source and verify_live_source with an explicit reviewed-fresh-cohort mode
existing launch HMAC, checkpoint ordering, phase_receipts and exact frame comparison validators
existing ordinary CLI checks and terminal profile controls

inventory.correction: 28,895 is the original visual count, not the extension-inclusive count. Earlier chat shorthand 28,721 original plus174 was incorrect; no inventory changed.

plan.operation: Create once using exclusive atomic publication. Store immutable canonical JSON and its digest before any application spawn.
bind: cohort id, exact four final binary hashes, physical source paths and source/toolchain identity
cohort registry and independent eligibility-review registry digests
runner revision and exact Python/helper/patch/extension/test-harness input digests
frozen source/test/snapshot digests and full sorted inventory including ignored flags
full original/extension/ordinary selections, exact chunk membership and checkpoint obligations
explicit environment, terminal profile/capabilities, fonts, controlled clocks, case data and dimensions
allowed phase capabilities, artifact roots, expected-store ownership and timeout<=225 seconds
run id and runner-secret identifier; never key bytes
plan.candidate_phase: Not present. A future separately reviewed comparison plan must reference immutable baseline evidence and checkpoint decisions; never mutate this plan to acquire comparison privileges.

advance.operation: Acquire exclusive run lock; validate plan digest and all bindings; execute at most one preplanned chunk or bounded ordinary-check group; atomically journal verified completion; return within225seconds.
pre_post: Validate all source/harness/cohort/review/tool inputs and private regular executable identities/hashes before and after each step.
Observe actual spawned image and process-start identity; validate complete ordered launch/checkpoint/close inventories using the existing HMAC protocol.
Check semantic readiness, input/resize/time intermediate checkpoints, full cell+cursor frames, mode restoration and cleanup.
Each visual scenario must produce its required nonzero ordered checkpoints; ordinary checks need their own prescribed outcomes, not invented frame checkpoints.
Capture attempts write to fresh isolated staging. Commit only a wholly verified chunk; failed or interrupted attempts remain evidence and cannot be reused as completed output.
Seal each committed expected chunk/store with exact manifest+digest and immutable ownership. Replay reads the same sealed expected bytes; reject missing, extra or changed artifacts.
Resume by re-verifying committed receipts/artifacts; do not trust an editable passed flag. Reject duplicate/reordered/skipped/wrong-case or zero-checkpoint records.
advance.receipt_secret: Keep the existing signing boundary. If resume needs retained per-run/per-chunk keys, store them only in a reviewed private0600 runner-owned location outside application working directories, artifact stores and Git; never log keys, put them in the immutable public plan, or pass them to application environments. Wrong/missing key fails closed.
advance.crash_rule: Use atomic chunk/result publication and an authenticated verification journal. A crash between staging and publication must leave a resumable uncommitted attempt, never a blessed partially captured expected store.

finalize.operation: No application launch. Revalidate every input pin, sealed store and ordered receipt chain, and union verified chunks against the entire registered inventory and all20ordinary checks.
requirements: No missing, duplicate, extra, skipped or zero-checkpoint visual case.
Every baseline replay frame and functional result exactly matches its captured counterpart under identical conditions.
Every prescribed ordinary CLI assertion, terminal mode and cleanup check completed.
Raw artifacts, recipe/argv/environment fingerprints, binary identities, checkpoint receipts and legacy-conflict observations remain linked and hashed.
finalize.result: fresh-baseline-evidence-complete or incomplete, with candidate_comparison_eligible=false, checkpoint_reference_approval=none, product_acceptance=false.

current_blockers: compare_live unconditionally calls load_reference_decisions and assumes candidate comparison
remove_circularity.minimal_change: An explicit separately reviewed fresh-cohort mode loads cohort eligibility and fixed source/harness pins without requiring any old tuple exception or historical build.json loader. Preserve the legacy path and its exact old-cohort checks. Use the existing phase-aware tuiscotti adapter to capture/replay fresh expected frames; collect old approval comparisons as separate diagnostic observations.
critical_rules: Do not rewrite or fabricate build-provenance.json, old build.json, old approvals or the old v1 decision.
Do not transfer the old stale-approval exception by source commit, similar image or matching live-frame hash.
Fresh baseline capture/replay may complete while legacy approval conflicts remain red and unresolved; report that honestly.
Only visual legacy-approval discrepancies belong in the diagnostic observer. Do not swallow functional/readiness/input/harness/IO errors or broadly convert failures to success.

Each conflict preserves both complete raw/decoded frames and context. Candidate comparison/acceptance requires an independent tuple- and cohort-specific decision after repeatable fresh baseline evidence.

required_regressions: Interrupted capture/replay step resumed with unchanged inputs; completed chunks are not silently rerun or omitted.
Plan, inventory, chunk partition, artifact, expected-frame, source, binary, physical identity, review row, or environment mutation rejected before next spawn.
Wrong/missing HMAC key, forged/truncated/reordered launch/checkpoint/close receipts, and cleanup failure rejected.
Unknown/mixed cohort, review aliases, symlink/hardlink/substituted candidate images and preexisting candidate-cache substitution remain rejected.
A deliberately altered cell, color, attribute, cursor, functional action, terminal mode or checkpoint order fails the relevant comparison.
Fresh baseline collection does not require historical tuple approval; old exception remains unusable by new cohort.
Candidate phase cannot be enabled with this fresh-capture-only review, and unresolved conflicts cannot become product acceptance.
boundedness: One advance<=225seconds. Choose immutable small chunks up front; if an individual case exceeds the bound, preserve an incomplete result and diagnose without dropping the case or changing the reference.
